summary: Lets two communicating SIP proxies reuse one congestion-controlled connection for requests in both directions. Because of this aliasing, both sides must authenticate with X.509 certificates over TLS, which is covered for TCP and SCTP. It also gives guidance on virtual servers and DNS SRV. It is a Proposed Standard.

eli5.summary: Instead of two phone lines between offices, they use one line for talking both ways, after each side proves who they are.

questions: reusing tls connections between sip proxies
